audit_title: TerraGuardian AI — NER Landslide Event Provenance & Source-Field Audit

audit_policy.rule_1_source_native_or_null: Do not invent or synthesize source_record_id values. If the source has no native database ID, source_record_id must be null and internal_reference_id must be used instead.
audit_policy.rule_2_explicit_coordinate_verification: Every coordinate must be explicitly classified as COORDINATE_SOURCE_VERIFIED, COORDINATE_APPROXIMATED, or COORDINATE_NOT_AVAILABLE.
audit_policy.rule_3_explicit_timestamp_verification: Every timestamp must be explicitly classified as TIMESTAMP_SOURCE_VERIFIED, TIMESTAMP_APPROXIMATED, or TIMESTAMP_NOT_AVAILABLE.
audit_policy.rule_4_remote_sensing_distinction: REMOTE_SENSING_ONLY must never be converted into or described as FIELD_VERIFIED.
audit_policy.rule_5_real_historical_vs_field_verified: A REAL_HISTORICAL classification does not imply TerraGuardian conducted ground/field verification. Field verification requires physical ground verification by local teams.
audit_policy.rule_6_controlled_demo_isolation: CONTROLLED_DEMO fixtures must make no claim to real event existence or independent provenance.

records.source_agency: North East Frontier Railway (NFR) / Geological Survey of India / ASDMA
records.source_dataset: ISRO NRSC Landslide Atlas of India (2023) & ASDMA Disaster Situation Bulletins May 2022
records.source_reference: NRSC/ISRO Landslide Atlas of India (2023), ISBN 978-93-94676-02-2, Chapter 4, Section 4.3; ASDMA Flood & Landslide Situation Report 15-May-2022; PIB Press Release 1826131
records.notes: Independently verified historical disaster: New Haflong railway station yard buried under massive debris flow on 15 May 2022. Ground-inspected by NFR/GSI engineering restoration teams; not field-verified by TerraGuardian. No native database ID in ASDMA/NRSC public reports; source_record_id is null.

records.source_agency: Geological Survey of India (Special Investigation Team) & ISRO NRSC
records.source_dataset: GSI Post-Disaster Geotechnical Investigation of Tupul Landslide (July 2022) / NRSC Landslide Atlas of India (2023)
records.source_reference: GSI Special Post-Disaster Geological Report (Aug 2022); NRSC Landslide Atlas of India (2023) Table 3.2; Ningthoujam et al., Current Science 123(5), 2022
records.notes: Independently verified catastrophic debris flow on 30 June 2022 along Ijei river at Tupul railway yard. Exact coordinates and timestamp recorded in GSI SIT report and peer-reviewed literature. Source document has no primary key ID string; source_record_id is null.

records.source_agency: Disaster Management & Rehabilitation Department (DM&R), Government of Mizoram / GSI
records.source_dataset: Mizoram State Disaster Management Authority Daily Disaster Situation Report (Cyclone Remal Response, 28 May 2024)
records.source_reference: Mizoram DM&R Emergency SitRep No. 28/05/2024; Geological Survey of India State Unit Mizoram Landslide Study (June 2024)
records.notes: Independently verified disaster: Cyclone Remal induced multiple fatal slope failures and reactivation of the Hunthar sinking area on NH-54 on 28 May 2024. Coordinates represent central crown of Hunthar zone. Documented in daily situation bulletins; source_record_id is null.

records.source_agency: Nagaland State Disaster Management Authority (NSDMA) / Home Department
records.source_dataset: NSDMA Incident Notification Bulletin (NH-29 Chumukedima Rockslide Incident)
records.source_reference: NSDMA Official Press Bulletin Ref. NSDMA-ER-2023/07/04; NDMA Daily National Incident Log 04-Jul-2023; NHIDCL Technical Site Inspection Report July 2023
records.notes: Independently verified fatal rockfall on 4 July 2023 at Old Chumukedima (Pagla Pahar) KM-36 on NH-29. Video and police dispatch logs pin exact time (~17:00 IST) and coordinates. Press release reference exists, but no database primary key; source_record_id is null.

records.source_agency: Geological Survey of India / Central Water Commission / NRSC
records.source_dataset: GSI Post-Disaster Geomorphological Survey of Teesta Basin Flash Flood and Landslides (Oct 2023) & NRSC Flood Inundation Maps
records.source_reference: GSI Preliminary Geological Assessment of the Flash Flood in Teesta River Basin, Sikkim (Nov 2023); NRSC ISRO Flood Inundation & Damage Mapping 05-Oct-2023; CWC Teesta Hydrograph Bulletin Oct 2023
records.notes: Independently verified GLOF-induced toe scouring and continuous corridor collapses along NH-10 on 4 October 2023. Regional mapping was executed primarily via satellite remote sensing (Sentinel/RISAT) due to ground inaccessibility. Verification mode is explicitly REMOTE_SENSING_ONLY; not field verified. source_record_id is null.

records.source_agency: Sikkim State Disaster Management Authority (SSDMA) / BRO Project Swastik
records.source_dataset: SSDMA Monsoon Disaster Situation Report (North Sikkim Landslides June 2024)
records.source_reference: SSDMA Daily Emergency Situation Report dated 13-06-2024; Press Information Bureau Gangtok Dispatch 14-Jun-2024; BRO Project Swastik Road Advisory
records.notes: Independently verified cloudburst and concurrent debris flows on 13 June 2024 cutting off Mangan. Sourced from daily emergency situation reports; coordinates represent arterial highway junction. source_record_id is null.
